# cci-fix-3 handoff

Successor of cci-fix-2 (handoff ccn doc ba570c7). The brief came by SendMessage from the release-v3 root. The owner rule makes every cci bug this lane's job, and prose may be written on Opus while codex is down.

## Landed

- Defect 14, v0.6.2, yasyf/cc-inbox#27 (squash 4a1ba08, release 32dc0d4): untracked holds now go through the same open-item scan as tracked ones (`store.open`, shared by `OpenItems` and `UntrackedHolds`). A post with `--resolves <seq>`, or a `lift` with `--re <seq>`, drops a hold from the digest's `untracked holds` line. Test: TestDigestDropsUntrackedHoldsAResolverCloses. On the live drive the line went from #3742, #3755 and #26051 to empty.
- Installed 0.6.2 everywhere: ~/.local/bin/cci (checksum-verified tarball), /opt/homebrew/bin/cci (cask, then the hard-link workaround because the first exec hit the syspolicyd wedge again), plugin cc-inbox@cc-inbox 0.6.2, and daemon com.yasyf.cc-inbox via `cci serve`. DONE record #26499.

## Loop mechanics

- Wait with `desk-wait.sh 570 ~/.claude/teams/session-67c0e5da/inboxes/<lane>.json=<cursor file> cci:release-v3:<lane>`, then run `cci grep --drive release-v3 'cci' --since <head>`. Cursor files live in ~/.claude/scratch/release-v3/cursors/. Set the cursor to the mailbox entry count at start, because the brief entry stays read=false.
- A PreToolUse hook refuses `desk-wait.sh ... -- <command>` and any other wait shape over 60 s. A bare desk-wait over the mailbox passes. To watch a release run, wait on the mailbox and then check `gh run view <id>`.
- Release mechanics are unchanged from ba570c7. PRs land with `gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch` once CI is green.

## Open

None. Store head was #26708 at 12:55 PM. The worktree is removed.
